newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Krupp seals 4 mln DM Yugo barter deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Krupp seals 4 mln DM Yugo barter deal - paper.

text.p: Germany's Krupp has concluded with Yugoslavia a barter deal to purchase four million German marks worth of steel components in exchange for spare parts, Belgrade daily Borba reported Wednesday.

Under the deal, Krupp will obtain steel components from Kolubara-Metali, the biggest producer within Serbia's power industry Elektroprivreda Srbije, and in turn will deliver spare parts, Borba quoted head of the Krupp Board of Directors Herbert Wiedenhues as saying.

"Krupp is interested in developing cooperation with Yugoslav firms which would lead to joint ventures," Wiedenhues said as he met the secretary of the Yugoslav Chamber of Commerce industry committee Ljubomir Todorovic in Belgrade.

The German concern saw a possibility for cooperation in Yugoslav companies producing mining components and steel constructions under Krupp licences while Krupp would purchase raw materials for its steelworks.
Yugoslav companies could also take part as sub-contractors in Krupp's car production deals, Wiedenhues said. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4305
